                    This price disclosure is an example based on average prices for Residential meter customers only, and
Electricity         does not necessarily reflect your actual TDU charges as a non-Residential meter customer. Your actual
Price               average price for electric service will vary according to your usage. The price you pay each month will
                    consist of the Base Charge, Energy Charge, and TDU Delivery Charges. TDU Delivery Charges include
                    all recurring charges from your TDU passed through to you without mark-up.
                    Each month your bill will also include (i) all applicable taxes, including sales tax and reimbursement for
                    the state miscellaneous gross receipts tax, (ii) TDU fees for underground service (if applicable at your
                    location), (iii) facility relocation fees or other charges ordered by a municipality. The average prices
                    listed above do not include any of the charges listed in (i), (ii) or (iii).
                    You will receive all contract documents and all other written communications from us via e-mail, text
                    message or other electronic means.
